# Heads or Tails — Online Coin Toss Game (Raxzen)

> Free, instant 3D online coin flip and heads or tails toss game at https://toss-heads-or-tails.raxzen.in/

## Overview
Heads or Tails by Raxzen is a fast, mobile-friendly browser tool and game for making fair 50/50 random decisions. It supports single flips, cricket tosses (head or tail / kata chapa / head ya tail), classroom activities, and multiplayer duels.

## Key Features
- **Instant 3D Coin Flip**: Smooth 3D coin spin with sound effects, haptic vibration, and particle burst.
- **Fair 50/50 Randomness**: Unbiased random outcome generation for every toss.
- **2-Player Duel Mode**: Best of 3, Best of 5, and Best of 7 head-to-head rounds.
- **Virtual Betting Mode**: Risk-free virtual coin wallet (1,000 starting coins) with Double or Nothing.
- **Live Statistics & Streak Tracker**: Tracks total tosses, Heads %, Tails %, current streak, and last 20 results.
- **4 Coin Skins & Themes**: Neon, Classic, Glass, and Indian Rupee (₹) coin styles.
